paragraphs.source_en: After Tokugawa Ieyasu returned to Edo, the atmosphere inside Osaka Castle began to take on a strange cast. Many daimyo who had seldom shown themselves before now came bearing seasonal gifts to pay their respects to Toyotomi Hideyori, who had lately grown with remarkable speed.
